chunks: And it was narrated from Ibn Faḍḍāl, who said:
Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام and said to him: "I performed one circuit, then dawn rose." He said: "Pray, then return and complete your saʿy."

key_terms.سَعَيْتُ: I performed saʿy, the ritual walking between Ṣafā and Marwah
key_terms.شَوْطًا: one circuit or lap of the ritual act
key_terms.ٱلْفَجْرُ: dawn, the beginning time of Fajr prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if Fajr begins while performing saʿy?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who is performing saʿy and the time of Fajr enters. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام instructs that the prayer should be performed first, and then the saʿy should be resumed and completed afterward.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2857 - It was narrated from Ibn Faddal who said:

Muhammad ibn Ali asked Imam Abu al-Hasan (as): "I completed one circuit of Sa'i (ritual walking), and then the dawn (Fajr) appeared."
Imam (as) replied: "Pray, then return and complete your Sa'i."
